title: View unpublished: This module allows granting access to unpublished nodes per content type. (CVE-2026-114537)
description: The View unpublished module for Drupal allows users with the "access content" permission to view published translations of nodes that have at least one unpublished translation, bypassing other node access restrictions. This issue requires a multilingual site with nodes having both unpublished and published translations, and the presence of other node access modules restricting view access. A fix is available for this vulnerability.
aiSummary: The View unpublished module grants users with the "access content" permission view access to published translations of nodes that have at least one unpublished translation. This behavior overrides restrictions imposed by other node access modules like Content Access or Domain Access. The vulnerability is conditional on the site being multilingual, nodes having both unpublished and published translations, and other node access modules restricting access to the published translations. The affected versions are all versions prior to 1.5.0. A patch is available to address this issue.
aiImpact: Users with the "access content" permission may bypass node access restrictions on published translations of nodes that have unpublished translations, potentially exposing content that should be restricted by other access control modules. The impact is limited by the requirement for a multilingual site and specific node translation states.
